description: This file provides utility functions for integrating Google reCAPTCHA into a SuiteCRM-based application. It includes functions to retrieve settings, verify reCAPTCHA responses, and display the reCAPTCHA widget or validation messages, facilitating bot prevention on forms.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template engine class instance used for rendering reCAPTCHA templates.

methods.name: getRecaptchaSettings
methods.description: Retrieves reCAPTCHA related settings from the Administration bean.

methods.name: getRecaptchaSiteKey
methods.description: Returns the public site key used for reCAPTCHA.

methods.name: getRecaptchaChallengeField
methods.description: Retrieves the reCAPTCHA challenge field from the request.

methods.name: getRecaptchaPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private key for reCAPTCHA verification.

methods.name: getRecaptchaEnabled
methods.description: Checks if reCAPTCHA is enabled in settings.

methods.name: isRecaptchaEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if reCAPTCHA is active (settings '1').

methods.name: getRecapthaResponse
methods.description: Gets the user's reCAPTCHA response from request.

methods.name: getRemoteIpAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address from server variables.

methods.name: verifyRecapthaResponse
methods.description: Verifies the reCAPTCHA response with Google's API.

methods.name: isRecapthaResponseVerified
methods.description: Checks if the reCAPTCHA verification was successful.

methods.name: getRecaptchaErrors
methods.description: Collects and formats error codes from reCAPTCHA response.

methods.name: displayRecaptchaValidation
methods.description: Performs validation of reCAPTCHA and logs results, returning success or errors.

methods.name: displayRecaptcha
methods.description: Displays the reCAPTCHA widget or disabled message based on settings.
